atlas.help: The atlas lists waters alphabetically. Open Map and zoom in for towns, roads and contour lines. The online topographic layer requests only visible map tiles from openmaps.fr, which receives your IP address and the area on screen. Turn it off for the offline overview. Tap a marker or group to choose a water. Waters without a published position remain in the list.

field-hints.accuracy: Were the details about the water, fish and conditions accurate in your experience?

field-hints.activity-month: Choose the calendar month for the contributed trips on this water.

field-hints.activityContribution.activit: Choose the method you used on this trip. It determines which method statistics include your trip.
Choose the fish you targeted on this trip. You can record a target even if you caught nothing.
field-hints.bait: Record the bait or lure, optionally including size and colour.
field-hints.biography: Describe your fishing experience or favourite techniques in more detail here.
field-hints.camera-photo: Take a picture while logging the catch. Verification depends on its location and capture data.
field-hints.catch-country-scope: The list starts with species recorded in the country of this trip. Choose all of Europe to search the full catalogue.
field-hints.catch-search: Search by common or scientific name. You can leave out accents.
field-hints.day: Choose the day you actually fished, even when recording it later.
field-hints.discussion-day: You can add the date of your trip to the reply so readers know when your experience took place.
field-hints.discussion-text: Signed-in anglers will see this post and your display name.
field-hints.fish: Choose a fish from the results or select Other species to enter a name. Open Rules for this catch to check the water and trip date.
field-hints.fish-country: This filters documented occurrences. Choose the country manually on borders or at sea.
field-hints.fish-name: You can describe an unidentified fish in your private journal.
field-hints.fish-query: Search a common or scientific name. Switch to All of Europe if the country list misses a species.
field-hints.fish-water-class: Select the water type shown on the permit for this water. The minimum size and water restrictions can differ between trout and non-trout waters.
field-hints.hometown: Enter the town or area you want on your profile. A street address is unnecessary.
field-hints.kind: Choose whether this point marks where you stood or where the fish took the bait.
field-hints.lat: Enter latitude in decimal degrees from −90 to 90. Use a minus sign south of the equator.
field-hints.length: Enter the measured length in centimetres, for example 42.5. Leave it blank if you did not measure the fish.
field-hints.lon: Enter longitude in decimal degrees from −180 to 180. Use a minus sign west of Greenwich.
field-hints.lookup-class: Check the type on your permit when it is missing from the atlas.
field-hints.lookup-species: Pick a species to see its recorded size and species restrictions for the selected day. Whole-water rules appear separately.
field-hints.market-water: Choose a water to see counts across all active offers there.
field-hints.market-water-search: Search by name or number, then select the water below to see its tips and statistics.
field-hints.match: Compare the promise before purchase with what you unlocked. Whether you caught a fish does not determine this score.
field-hints.message-text: This text goes to the recipient shown in the conversation. Insert emoji using your keyboard.
field-hints.newCatch.technique: Describe how you fished, such as spinning or float fishing. This is saved with the catch in your journal.
field-hints.notes: Private trip notes. Saving does not publish them.
field-hints.offer-access: Indicate where the buyer can use the technique, such as from shore or a boat.
field-hints.offer-country: Limits species choices here and in the catalogue. Choose the water shown on the offer separately.
field-hints.offer-day: Enter the day you used the technique. Buyers can see this date in the offer preview.
field-hints.offer-limit: This caps lifetime purchases across versions. Leave it empty for unlimited sales.
field-hints.offer-price: This is how many test credits the buyer spends to unlock the tip. Credits have no cash value.
field-hints.offer-species: Choose the fish your technique targets. The offer stores its scientific name.
field-hints.offer-technique: Write the full instructions here. Before purchase only you can see them.
field-hints.offer-title: Use a short description that tells the buyer what the tip covers.
field-hints.offer-water: Choosing a water lists the offer on its page. Omitting it keeps the offer in the general market.
field-hints.offer-water-search: Enter part of the name, number or organisation, then choose the specific water for this offer from the list below.
field-hints.outcome: Choose the outcome supported by what the photograph actually shows.
field-hints.photo: Choose a picture on this phone to store with the catch.
field-hints.profile-photo: Choose a profile image from this device and check its preview before saving.
field-hints.public-day: Show the exact catch date on the public card in addition to the month.
field-hints.public-length: Include the length from the photo review on the public card.
field-hints.public-photo: Include the catch photo on the public card. Check the background before publishing.
field-hints.public-water: Include the registered water on the public card for anyone with its link.
field-hints.review-length: Enter the length in centimetres for the review outcome you selected. No length is recorded for insufficient evidence.
field-hints.rule-country: Choose the country where you plan to fish. Each rule has its own territorial scope and source.
field-hints.rule-date: Select your fishing date. Closed seasons vary during the year and the water pack has a validity period.
field-hints.rule-water: The selected water determines local size limits, sections and restrictions.
field-hints.rule-water-search: Search by name or water number. One match shows its rules immediately. If several waters match, tap one of the suggestions below the search field.
field-hints.search: Search by water name, registry number or town. In Favorites the search covers only your saved waters.
field-hints.section: Choose the part of the water where you plan to fish. The main channel and side sections can have different rules.
field-hints.share-bait: Include the bait you recorded for the catch in the message.
field-hints.share-day: Show the recipient the exact trip date.
field-hints.share-length: Include the catch length from your journal in the message.
field-hints.share-photo: Attach the catch photo to the shared message. Check what is visible in the background.
field-hints.share-technique: Include the technique you recorded for this catch.
field-hints.share-tip-text: Write the message for the recipient. Private notes are not included automatically.
field-hints.share-water: Include the water name from the trip in the message.
field-hints.shared: Save with this option enabled to show your profile to other signed-in anglers.
field-hints.species: Choose the species whose closed season you want to check for the selected section and day.
field-hints.species-filter: Type part of a local or scientific name, then choose a species from the list.
field-hints.tagline: Write a short line to introduce yourself on your angler profile.
field-hints.technique: Did the description explain how to repeat the technique?
field-hints.tip-group: Members of the selected group can see this tip. Check the group name before sending.
field-hints.trip-search: Find saved trips by the water name or its published number. Spaces and accents are optional. Clear the search to see all trips.
field-hints.water: Select a listed water to link the trip to the atlas. A custom name belongs to your local journal.
field-hints.water-country: The selected country applies to search results, favorites and nearby waters.
field-hints.water-name: Name the water for this private trip. A custom name stays outside the water atlas.
field-hints.water-parking: Show waters with a documented car park in the current list or map. Open a water to choose a car park and start navigation.
field-hints.water-search: Search the offline atlas by name or number. Tap a suggestion, or use the text as a private water name for this trip. Clearing the search restores your last choice.

help-topics.accounts.steps.1: Register with email and password. Confirm the message on the same phone and complete your profile. Next time use the password or device unlock if you enabled it.
help-topics.accounts.steps.2: For a forgotten password request a reset and use the latest email link. Use Android Back to return from your mail app. Account settings let you sign out and show the contact for erasure requests.
help-topics.accounts.title: Account, sign-in and recovery
help-topics.activity.steps.1: On a completed trip choose Trip contribution. Select a target and method and check the fish count. Blank trips may contribute too.
help-topics.activity.steps.2: Open Water activity on a water and select the month. The figures describe contributed trips. Manage or withdraw your contributions under Profile.
help-topics.activity.title: Trip statistics
help-topics.catalog.steps.1: Choose a country or tap Find country by location. Coordinates are compared with borders on your phone. Near a border or at sea, select the country yourself.
help-topics.catalog.steps.2: Search using a local or scientific name. Country lists use occurrence records and published checklists. The same country selection is available when creating an offer. The full catalogue also includes species without such records. Open a species for its scientific name, available distribution and sources.
help-topics.catalog.steps.3: Select the country and, for Czech waters, the water type. Compare the minimum size and species restrictions with the local rules for the fishing date. Whole-water restrictions have their own section. Report an error on the species card to open an email draft for the catalogue maintainer.
help-topics.catalog.title: Fish catalogue and location
help-topics.catch.steps.1: Search for a species in the trip country or across Europe. Choose Other species for a manual entry. Enter the measured length in centimetres and optionally the bait or technique. Open Rules for this catch to check the trip date and water while writing.
help-topics.catch.steps.2: To document a catch photograph the whole fish at the water with a scale. A private point can mark the angler’s position or the bite location. The phone requests location when you tap.
help-topics.catch.title: Catch, photo and location
help-topics.evidence.steps.1: Save the capture to the catch first. Submit it from its detail and open My submitted catch photos under Profile to see the outcome or withdraw.
help-topics.evidence.steps.2: An assigned reviewer distinguishes a measured length from an estimate using a known-size reference. A gallery photo can stay in the journal.
help-topics.evidence.title: Photo review
help-topics.forum.steps.1: Open the angler contributions on a water. Share an observation, ask a question or open a thread and reply to a particular post. The question author can mark a helpful answer.
help-topics.forum.steps.2: You can withdraw your own text until someone replies to it. Report a problematic post. Use a private reply to talk to one angler.
help-topics.forum.title: Water discussions
help-topics.groups.steps.1: Open Account and group settings from Profile. Create a group or enter an invitation. An owner issues a single-use code. A new code replaces the previous one. Leaving removes access to group tips.
help-topics.groups.steps.2: On a photographed catch choose Enter catch of the week and select the group. Members can vote on other catches in the round. Open past rounds from the board.
help-topics.groups.title: Groups and catch of the week
help-topics.journal.steps.1: Start a trip from the journal or a water. Choose a suggested water or use a private name, set the day and save even a trip without a catch. In My trips, search by water name or number.
help-topics.journal.steps.2: Open the saved trip and add each catch. The journal works offline. Deleting a trip removes its local catches and photos. Manage published copies separately.
help-topics.journal.title: Journal and trips
help-topics.market.steps.1: Open Tip market on the home screen. Each offer shows its author, target fish, price, sales and availability. Opening it from a water filters the list to that water.
help-topics.market.steps.2: The tip rating comes from purchases of that offer. The author rating covers all their rated sales. Sales and ratings do not measure the number of fish caught.
help-topics.market.steps.3: Claim test credits, open a tip and confirm the displayed price. Purchased tips retains the unlocked version after withdrawal. After a connection failure you can retry.
help-topics.market.title: Market, purchases and statistics
help-topics.messages.steps.1: Open Private messages from Profile. Start a new conversation using a private reply to a question. Check the recipient before sending.
help-topics.messages.steps.2: Type emoji in the text with your keyboard. React attaches an emoji to a particular message. Change or remove your own reaction. Block a participant or report a message in the thread.
help-topics.messages.title: Messages and reactions
help-topics.profile.steps.1: Under Profile edit your available profile fields, portrait and biography. The publish switch controls visibility to other signed-in anglers. Find shared profiles in the directory.
help-topics.profile.steps.2: The profile distinguishes photo-documented catches from ratings of sold tips. Your purchased instructions are in the market on your account.
help-topics.profile.title: Profile and privacy
help-topics.ratings.steps.1: Open the purchased tip and score accuracy, clarity of the method and whether the content matched the offer before purchase. Choose 1 to 5 for each and confirm.
help-topics.ratings.steps.2: If the author promised a shore technique for zander and delivered it, the content matched the offer. This can be true even if you caught nothing.
help-topics.ratings.title: How to rate a tip
help-topics.sell.steps.1: Choose Offer a technique in the market. Select a catalogue species and optionally a listed water. These choices determine where people can find the offer.
help-topics.sell.steps.2: Write the buyer instructions, set the price and optionally cap total sales. Check the public preview before publishing. Edit or withdraw listings under My offers.
help-topics.sell.title: How to publish a tip
help-topics.share.steps.1: Choose sharing on a catch or trip. Select the fields to include, review the preview and choose Android sharing or your group.
help-topics.share.steps.2: Anyone with the public card link can read it. Revoke it under Profile, My public cards. Recipients may retain copies saved earlier.
help-topics.share.title: Sharing and public cards
help-topics.start.steps.1: From the home screen open the tip market, open the fish catalogue or search for a water by name, number or town. Bookmark a water to save it on this phone.
help-topics.start.steps.2: In the atlas, select a country or choose Sort by location. Your phone measures the distance to the mapped water or its nearest known point. Waters without coordinates stay at the end.
help-topics.start.steps.3: Open Settings to enlarge the text, keep the screen on, manage offline atlas updates or choose alerts. Nearby waters use approximate location on this phone while the journal is open. Post alerts check public water discussions when Android allows background work.
help-topics.start.steps.4: Use the bottom bar for the atlas, seasons and your journal. Profile opens your account, groups and messages. Help also works while filling in a form.
help-topics.start.title: Getting started
help-topics.waters.steps.1: Tap the water map to choose a maps app. A marked access point is used when the source supplies one. Otherwise the map opens a published point on the water, or searches for the name if coordinates are missing. The source link opens the original record.
help-topics.waters.steps.2: Choose the water, fish and date in Seasons and sizes. Czech register entries distinguish national minimum sizes, species closures and whole-water closures. Check the manager’s record for additional conditions. Your journal can reopen this screen with the trip date.
help-topics.waters.steps.3: Low water, fish deaths and reported closures are counted separately for each water. Three distinct accounts reporting the same issue within 24 hours highlight the alert. You can withdraw your own report. Check current fishing restrictions with the manager.
help-topics.waters.title: Waters, size limits and seasons
